message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Slow nightly tests
on:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '42 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  slow-tests:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'Qiskit'
    name: Full-test-run-with-slow
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        name: Install Python
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('constraints.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install Rust
        run: rustup toolchain install --profile minimal --no-self-update
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip
          python -m pip install -U \
            -c constraints.txt \
            --group test \
            --group optionals-all \
            -e .
        env:
          QISKIT_BUILD_PROFILE: release
      - name: Run all tests including slow
        run: stestr run --slowest --abbreviate
        env:
          RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
          QISKIT_TESTS: "run_slow"
          QISKIT_IGNORE_USER_SETTINGS: TRUE
      - name: Create comment on failed test run
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v5
        with:
          issue-number: 7864
          body: |
            Nightly slow test run failed at commit ${{ github.sha }}.

            _Logs_: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}.
",
  "rationale": "Add pip dependency caching to avoid repeated downloads on each nightly run, supported by evidence showing ~6% elapsed time reduction (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2, experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9). Add a custom job timeout of 60 minutes (observed runs ~40-43 minutes) to prevent runaway consumption, supported by evidence that custom timeouts reduce runaway job time (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508, experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8). Both changes preserve test coverage and required checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--112e2b2e7fbe04b8"]
}

```yaml
name: Slow nightly tests
on:
  schedule:
    - cron:  '42 3 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  slow-tests:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'Qiskit'
    name: Full-test-run-with-slow
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v7
        name: Install Python
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('constraints.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
      - name: Install Rust
        run: rustup toolchain install --profile minimal --no-self-update
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install -U pip
          python -m pip install -U \
            -c constraints.txt \
            --group test \
            --group optionals-all \
            -e .
        env:
          QISKIT_BUILD_PROFILE: release
      - name: Run all tests including slow
        run: stestr run --slowest --abbreviate
        env:
          RUST_BACKTRACE: 1
          QISKIT_TESTS: "run_slow"
          QISKIT_IGNORE_USER_SETTINGS: TRUE
      - name: Create comment on failed test run
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v5
        with:
          issue-number: 7864
          body: |
            Nightly slow test run failed at commit ${{ github.sha }}.

            _Logs_: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}.
```
